meta.title: Chrome browser
meta.description: Let the agent drive Chrome: navigate, screenshot, snapshot, click, fill, evaluate JS, and inspect console and network; supports four connection schemes (launch / autoConnect the current browser / debugging port / WebSocket endpoint) that can be switched at any time.

settings.title: Chrome browser
settings.description: Choose how the plugin connects to Chrome, configure the debugging endpoint and launch options, test the connection, and inspect the status.
